Hi Pacific Coast Academy Invoicing Team,

Thank you so much for the detailed update and for confirming those payments!

We will get invoice 53034 for certificate PAC-113276-C045 ($225.00) sent over to you right away. Please let us know if you need any additional documentation or have any questions.

We truly appreciate your partnership and quick communication on this.

Warm regards,
A+ Tutoring Team

Hi Cherri,

Thank you so much for the detailed update — we really appreciate you looking into each of these!

We will resubmit the outstanding invoices (53014, 53015, 53016, 53087, 54359, and 54373) through the Heartland Invoice Submission Form with an invoice date of 8/11/26 or later. We will also note checks #34714 and #34981 for the two paid invoices on our end.

Please let us know if anything else is needed from us.

Warm regards,
A+ Tutoring Team

Hi Edwin, thank you for reaching out! We are A+ Tutoring, an academic tutoring service for K-12 students. Unfortunately, we do not offer Jiu-jitsu or martial arts lessons. You may want to search for local martial arts studios in your area. We hope you find the right fit for your kids! A+ Tutoring Team

Hi Diane, thank you for sending over this cancellation notice. We confirm receipt of the Service PO Cancellation for Emma Savoie, PO 1433577. We understand that 0 sessions are billable and that no further services will be provided to this student under the school's authorization. Please let us know if you need anything else from our end.

A+ Tutoring Team

Hi Katherine,

Thank you for the purchase order for Ibraheem Siddique. To get scheduling set up we still need the parent/guardian contact information for the family:

  - Parent/guardian full name
  - Email address
  - Phone number

Could you reply with those when you have a moment? We'll take it from there.

A+ Tutoring Team

Hi Aamer, thank you so much for reaching out! We would love to support Adil with ELA this semester. Here are answers to your questions. Yes, we have tutors experienced with 9th grade English, including reading comprehension and analytical writing at the high school level. Our rate through PCI is $75 per hour, and there is no registration fee or minimum session commitment. We absolutely work alongside a student's existing curriculum, so we can align sessions with what Adil is covering in class. To get started through Valley View Charter Prep, the next step is typically a Materials/Class Request submitted through PCI. We can coordinate with Marcella Montez on the school side once that is initiated. In the meantime, we are happy to do a free intro call to talk through goals and find the best tutor match. Would any of those time windows work for a quick call this week? Looking forward to working with Adil! A+ Tutoring Team
